import { Card, Text } from '@app/design-system'
import Link from 'next/link'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { resolveOrgs } from '../../../lib/auth/session'
import { t } from '../../../lib/i18n'
import { createRequestScopedClient } from '../../../lib/supabase/server'

// Every workspace the signed-in user holds a seat in, with the role they hold there. The
// org picker at /o redirects straight through when there is exactly one; this page never
// does, so a user always has one place that lists every seat.
//
// The signed-in check is the (protected) layout's. The read is resolveOrgs(), the seam the
// picker uses, so the two pages cannot disagree about which orgs a user holds.
export const metadata = { title: t('route.workspaces') }

export default async function WorkspacesPage(): Promise<ReactNode> {
  const orgs = await resolveOrgs(await createRequestScopedClient())

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6 px-6 py-10">
      <Text as="h1" size="2xl" weight="semibold">
        {t('route.workspaces')}
      </Text>

      {orgs.length === 0 ? (
        <Card testID={'workspaces-empty'}>
          <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
            <Text weight="medium">{t('workspaces.empty.title')}</Text>
            <Text tone="muted" size="sm">
              {t('workspaces.empty.description')}
            </Text>
            <Link href="/o" className="text-sm font-medium text-ink underline">
              {t('workspaces.empty.action')}
            </Link>
          </div>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {orgs.map((org) => (
            <li
              key={org.id}
              className="rounded-lg border border-line px-4 py-3"
              data-testid={`workspace-${org.slug}`}
            >
              <span className="font-medium text-ink">{org.name}</span>
              <span className="ml-2 text-sm text-ink-muted">{org.role}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </main>
  )
}
